detailedInfo: Here you will find detailed information for the adoption of FacturaGPT.
timeTrackingDigitalSignConfig: Time tracking and digital signature system settings
yourAccountDescription: In Settings you can manage your account settings, ensuring that it adapts to your needs and preferences.
currentPlanHistoryDescription: View and manage your plan in Settings > General:
reviewPaymentHistory: Review your payment history and manage your subscription.
changePlan: Make changes to your plan according to your business needs.
overlimitNotification: Recognitions: if you exceed your contracted limit in the month, the system will automatically notify you.
languageDescription: FacturaGPT is available in English and Spanish. You can change the language in Settings > General.
currencyDescription: Select the billing display currency from Settings > General.
chatsDescription: You can delete old conversations to keep your space organized. Once deleted, chats cannot be recovered.
connectionsDescription: Optimize your business systems integration by connecting FacturaGPT with other tools.
setupAutomation: Go to Settings > Connections > New automation to configure a custom integration.
workflowOrchestration: You can also access it from the “+” button > Automate for workflow orchestration.
manageConnections: Manage and supervise all active connections from Settings > Connections.
teamDescription: Assign and control permissions for efficient and secure collaboration. Define access levels according to each user's role, ensuring traceability and optimized management of documents and transactions.
teamInfoDescription: Manage your team in Settings > Team. Each team member is assigned a location within FacturaGPT by the general administrator. Users with permissions at that location can access files and features according to their role.
typesRoles: Types of roles and available permissions
editorDescription: Allows document approval/cancellation and status changes.
collaboratorDesc: Requests access for document approval/cancellation and status changes.
bothEditorsAndContributors: Both editors and collaborators can have different access levels:
completeSynchronization: Full synchronization with the team. Access to documents, automations, contacts, assets, discounts and taxes.
limitedAccess: Limited synchronization only to documents and specific features according to assigned permissions.
configurationDigital: Time tracking and digital signature system configuration
facturagptTools: FacturaGPT offers advanced tools for HR traceability, enabling workday logging and digital validation of documents.
signingSystem1: Register employees' work hours with schedule control.
signingSystem2: Automate attendance reports and sync with payroll.
signingSystem3: Manage permissions and vacations within the system.
digitalSignature1: Allows electronic signing of HR docs, contracts, and invoices.
digitalSignature3: Compliant with secure digital signature regulations.
mergePlanDesc: You can merge your plan with another account to consolidate billing and receive a single invoice at the end of the month.
mergePlan1: Go to Settings > Team and Access.
mergePlan2: Choose the account you want to unify billing with.
mergePlan4: Confirm the merge and review the changes in the billing area.
idealForCompanies: Ideal for companies using document recognition from different accounts.
AppsDescription: Optimize your workflow with smart agents, process automation, and real-time notifications.
AppsInfoDesc: If you have a paid plan on FacturaGPT, you can customize your agents by adjusting their knowledge, response tone, and context from the agent creation panel under the "agents" tab.
AppsImportant: Important: Before implementing, make sure to test to ensure proper functioning, as errors may occur.
facturagptConnectBusiness: FacturaGPT enables connection with various business tools and platforms to automate workflows.
detailsAvailableSoon: More details on available integrations coming soon.
monitorAutomation: Monitor automation and set up smart variables to anticipate strategies.
receiveAlerts: Receive alerts in “ : : ” about any change or automated process.
monitorYourTeams: Monitor your team's activity and record their interactions within the platform.
stayInformed: Stay informed in real time about key events in your system.
documentManagementDesc: Smart folders enable efficient and automated document management, optimizing your business operations.
toManageDocuments: To manage documents in FacturaGPT, you can:
uploadFilesManually: Upload files manually from the “+” button > Upload Document
dragAndDropFiles: Drag and drop files to upload quickly.
automateSynchronization: Automate synchronization with data sources for real-time information updates.
atBottomScreen: At the bottom of the screen you can see the folder you are in
customizeConcepts: Customize document concepts to improve organization and traceability:
customizeConeptsList1: Travel: Recording and calculating travel expenses.
customizeConeptsList2: Payroll: Automatic calculation of taxes and salary deductions.
customizeConeptsList3: Agreements and Contracts: Extraction and management of contract lifecycles.
customizeConeptsList4: Enrollment: Applicable in education, automotive, and other sectors.
customizeConeptsList5: Customs documents: Automation and validation of regulatory compliance.
customizeConeptsList6: Other concepts: Flexible adaptation for specific needs.
quickActionsList1: Share and send documents by email directly from FacturaGPT.
quickActionsList2: Duplicate files to generate copies without losing key information.
quickActionsList3: Download files in multiple formats as needed.
quickActionsList4: Add notes and comments for better tracking and collaboration.
quickActionsList5: Move documents within the system flexibly.
quickActionsList6: Print documents directly from FacturaGPT with no prior downloads needed.
quickActionsList7: Automate one or more tasks with platform interoperability to reduce manual workload.
contactManagementDesc: Efficiently manage contacts, enabling creation, import, setup, and export of data.
addContacts: Add contacts from "Add contact" or by scanning a document, saving it for future transactions.
editInformation: Edit information in real time from Contact Management, selecting the contact to update or delete data.
facturagptDetectsDuplicates: FacturaGPT detects duplicates and lets you manage them to keep your database organized.
importContactsDesc: Bulk import allows you to integrate databases into FacturaGPT quickly and efficiently.
importcontactsList1: Import contacts from CSV or XLS files using the icon and uploading the file
importcontactsList2: Sync contacts with accounting and CRM platforms from “+” > Automate
configurationOptionsList1: Custom tags and categories to efficiently segment clients and suppliers.
configurationOptionsList2: Definition of payment conditions and setting multiple billing details.
configurationOptionsList3: Custom parameters allowing information to be tailored to each company.
configurationOptionsList4: Define parameters to improve database organization and customization according to business needs.
exportYourList: Export your contact list in a structured way to integrate with other business systems.
automateYourContactList: Automate your contact list “+” > Automate to add connection with accounting and CRM tools.
advancedContact: Advanced contact filtering to select and extract only relevant information.
historyTraceabilityDesc: Analyze client and supplier behavior through key metrics and transaction logs. Consult financial metrics in chat for generative analysis or from the control panel for more detail.
historyTraceabilityList1: View the evolution of transactions and financial patterns associated with each contact.
historyTraceabilityList2: View transactions in table format using the "See transactions" button in the Contact Management table for structured review.
historyTraceabilityList3: Access key information from the main chat to speed up data queries.
historyTraceabilityList4: Compare transactions between contacts and detect trends in suppliers to optimize decision making.
historyTraceabilityList5: Access data from the chat for quick queries or from the panel for in-depth analysis.
assetManagementDesc: Advanced management of products and services, ensuring total control of assets through parameter assignment, traceability, and automation.
assetManagementList1: Add assets manually or by scanning documents related to inventories or purchases.
assetManagementList2: Record technical specifications, supplier, cost, location, and status of each asset.
assetManagementList3: Edit information in real time from Asset Management, selecting the asset to update data or delete it.
assetManagementList4: FacturaGPT detects duplicate assets and lets you manage them to keep your inventory organized.
assetManagementList5: Automate inventory control with scheduled rules from " + " > Automate (in progress).
discountsTaxesDesc: Manage discounts and taxes applied to products and services registered as assets.
customSettingsList1: Assign multiple custom parameters to each asset for detailed management.
customSettingsList3: Manage assets by location in different warehouses or points of sale.
customSettingsList4: Add attachments to each asset (PDFs, technical datasheets, manuals).
exportAssetsDesc: Export your asset list in a structured way to integrate with other business systems.
historyTraceabilityDesc2: Analyze asset performance using key metrics and transaction logs.
historyTraceabilityDesc2List1: See key metrics from the main chat for quick analysis or from the dashboard for a more detailed view.
historyTraceabilityDesc2List2: View the evolution and usage patterns associated with each asset.
historyTraceabilityDesc2List3: Consult transactions in table format using the "See transactions" button in the Asset Management table.
historyTraceabilityDesc2List4: Compare assets and detect trends in purchases or maintenance to optimize decisions.
historyTraceabilityDesc2List5: Access the data from the chat for quick queries or from the panel for in-depth analysis.
transactionsDesc: Optimize financial management through automated reconciliation and real-time reports with Stripe. It facilitates invoice generation, document approval, and payment and collection automation.
createATransaction: Create an invoice from "+" > New Invoice or directly from a contact file.
configureinvoiceLocation: Set invoice location and recurrence, with an option to rename generated documents.
analyzeTransactions: Analyze transactions from FacturaGPT chat with generative analysis or check “Income and Expenses” on the dashboard.
documentAprovalDesc: Only the administrator and editors can approve documents. Collaborators require specific permissions to manage billable documents.
documentAprovalList1: Review and authorization of invoices, payment orders, and transactions.
documentAprovalList2: Configurable approval flow according to roles within the company.
documentAprovalList3: Automatic notifications about documents pending approval.
documentsImpacts: Each document impacts accounting according to its financial status:
documentsImpactsList1: Draft → In editing, no tax impact.
documentsImpactsList3: Defaulted → Not paid within the agreed period.
documentsImpactsList4: Expired → Exceeded the deadline without receiving payment.
documentsImpactsList5: Cancelled → Cancelled document, no accounting impact.
paymentAutomationDesc: Automatically record and categorize payments as income and expenses. Enables automation of supplier payments and efficient management of direct debits, avoiding delays and optimizing financial reconciliation.
paymentAutomationDescList4: One-time or recurring payments (monthly, weekly, yearly).
paymentAutomationDescList5: Available payment methods: SEPA, cards, bank transfers.
paymentAutomationDescList6: Enable due date alerts to get reminders before payment.
paymentAutomationDescList7: Save and activate the automation so FacturaGPT manages your payments automatically.
paymentAutomationDescList8: Automate your payments with FacturaGPT and maintain effortless financial control.
facturagptWillAllowAutomatedInvoice: Soon, FacturaGPT will allow you to manage automated refunds of invoices and assets through Stripe.
controlPanelDesc: Monitor key indicators, income, expenses, and operational management, providing a real-time view of financial performance.
kpiMonitoringList1: Check key metrics like storage, income, and expenses in real time from the control panel.
kpiMonitoringList2: See the recognitions used during the month in Apps “ : : ” or in your plan history in Settings > General.
incomeExpensesDec: Check the financial balance of income and expenses from the panel or use the chat for generative analysis.
timeTrackingManagementDesc: View days, hours worked and estimated for each employee and use “+” > Automate to manage and optimize HR management.
securityDesc: In Settings you can manage your FacturaGPT account configuration, ensuring it fits your needs and preferences. For more information visit the Terms and Privacy Policy page.
documentCustodyDesc: Standard legal period: 4 years. Although some industries require up to 7 years of document custody.
deleteAccountWarning: Important: Account deletion is permanent and irreversible. All your documents, settings, and stored data will be deleted. How to delete your account in FacturaGPT:
stepsToRecoveryPassword: If you forgot your password or can't access it, follow these steps to reset:
stepsToRecoveryPasswordList1: On the login screen, select "Forgot your password?".
stepsToRecoveryPasswordList2: Enter the email address associated with your account.
stepsToRecoveryPasswordList3: You'll receive a validation code by email.
stepsToRecoveryPasswordList5: Create and confirm a new password.
stepsToRecoveryPasswordList6: Log in again with your new password.
codeRecoveryPassword: If you do not receive the code, check the spam folder or wait a few minutes before trying again.
